final_candidates.decision_summary: Tryptophan at position 17 is a large aromatic residue likely critical for structural packing; proline substitution maximally disrupts local backbone geometry and removes a key hydrophobic anchor in the YWY motif.

Leucine at position 11 resides in a predicted alpha-helical segment (residues 8-14); proline is the strongest helix breaker and would disrupt this secondary structure element essential for PsaE folding.

Phenylalanine at position 40 is likely buried in the hydrophobic core of this small protein; introducing a charged aspartate would create a severely destabilizing buried charge and disrupt core packing.
